resale_co.name: Certificate of Land Use Compliance (Certificate of Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Zoning Official, Borough of Cape May Point
resale_co.lead_time: Issued or rejected within 10 business days of receiving the application
resale_co.valid_for: 180 days after issuance, for one transfer only
requirements: Inspection of the premises by the Zoning Officer to confirm the structure or unit complies with the Borough Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 150); the Tax Assessor may come along to update the property record
The certificate confirms the property may continue to be used as before and lists the number and designation of units
Interior inspection: send a key or give a lock box code with the application
Not needed for new construction whose original certificate of occupancy was issued within 18 months of the transfer
A tenant under an existing lease may stay, but title may not transfer until the certificate is issued

fees.label: Certificate of Land Use Compliance inspection, per unit (not over $300 per building)
fees.quote: Enclosed is the $100.00 fee/unit (not to exceed $300 per building) for this inspection.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Certificate of Compliance Application (name, mailing address, unit, street address, block, lot, date of settlement, and a key or lock box code for the interior inspection) and send it with the $100.00 per unit fee to the Office of the Zoning Official, Borough of Cape May Point, PO Box 490, Cape May Point, NJ 08212 (215 Lighthouse Avenue). Office hours are 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM Tuesday and Wednesday only.

evidence.quote: No person, persons or organization of persons shall sell or transfer title to any structure, portion of a structure or unit in a structure until such person, persons or organization of persons shall have first obtained a certificate of land use compliance certifying:

Before a certificate of land use compliance shall be issued, the Zoning Officer or his designee shall make an inspection of the premises to determine if the structure, part of a structure or unit complies with the Zoning Ordinance of the Borough of Cape May Point.

The fee for a certificate of land use compliance shall be $100 per unit, whether such unit is a dwelling unit or a business or commercial unit, not to exceed $300 for the building, and shall be payable upon submission of an application therefor.
A certificate of land use compliance shall be valid for a period of 180 days after issuance but shall only be valid for one transfer of the subject property.
Please Inspect the following structure or unit:
4:00 PM to 6:00 PM Tuesday and Wednesday Only

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Chapter 67, Certificate of Land Use Compliance (ecode360 CA0524, read through the print view), bars any sale or transfer of title to a structure or unit until the seller gets the certificate, and bars a buyer from occupying without it. The Zoning Officer inspects for zoning compliance and the certificate is issued or rejected within 10 business days. The code fee ($100 per unit, not over $300 per building, Ord. No. 16-2024) matches the Borough's Certificate of Compliance Application (January 2025), so only the form fee is listed. It is a zoning/land use check, not a full housing or building code inspection. The Borough's construction code work is done by the City of Cape May Construction Office under a shared services contract (Construction Official Lou Vito, 609-884-9555 x7). Cape May Point requires annual rental fire inspections before a rental permit is issued (Chapter 126; Code Enforcement / Rental Inspector Brady Schoenrock, 609-884-8468 x21); that is a rental program, not a resale requirement. Chapter 106 (lead-based paint inspections) applies to rentals only. The Borough website blocks rapid automated requests, so pages were fetched slowly.

requirements: The State application certifies smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms and the secondary power source identification label (homes with solar, generators or battery systems); it no longer lists a fire extinguisher

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the DCA Fire Safety portal ('Start Your Smoke Certification Application'). Payment by e-check or credit card is required before submitting, and a valid email address is required. Homes heated by electricity with no CO alarm requirement should also email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.

fire_cert.notes: The DCA registry lists Cape May Point as 'S' (the State enforces the fire code) and DCA's July 17, 2026 list of state-enforced towns marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). Borough Code Chapter 88 still says the fire code is locally enforced by a Borough Bureau of Fire Prevention, but the current DCA registry and directory (survey 7/31/2026) show the State as the enforcing agency, so the State is used here. Fees are the state fees under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d), cited from the NJ Register adoption; apply through the DCA Fire Safety online portal. The DCA Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement page lists Louis Kilmer with phone (609) 633-6106; the state fire directory lists (609) 633-6132. The volunteer Cape May Point Fire Company is not the enforcing agency.
